name: Data Engineer
responsibilities: Design and document database and data warehouse architecture that other teams' pipelines and dashboards depend on for years
Build data models, schemas, and interfaces (partitions, indexes, transfer mechanisms) that scale and stay fast as data volume grows
Integrate new data sources into existing warehouse structures without breaking what already runs on them
skills: Data modeling and schema design that survives new sources and new scale
Database management and query languages, plus cloud-based storage and warehouse platforms
Enforcing and documenting standards (naming, schemas, access control) so the warehouse stays usable as a team, not a pile of tables
Systems analysis: tracing how a broken pipeline or slow query affects everything downstream
rawSkillPool: Database architecture and data warehouse design
Data base user interface and query software (SQL)
Data partitioning, indexing, and performance tuning
Integrating disparate systems and data sources

evidence.quote: Design strategies for enterprise databases, data warehouse systems, and multidimensional networks. Set standards for database operations, programming, query processes, and security. Model, design, and construct large relational databases or data warehouses.
